english: Never question me again.
chinese: 别再质疑我。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: The key to victory.
chinese: 胜利的关键。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: I made some new friends while I was away.
chinese: 我离开期间结识了不少新朋友。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: And the Orb?
chinese: 那宝珠在哪里？
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: You are useless.
chinese: 你真没用。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: That creature killed my father, and you let him escape.
chinese: 那怪物杀了我父亲，你却让它逃了。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: I've no more time to waste.
chinese: 我没时间再浪费了。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: I must have the Orb if I am to rule.
chinese: 要成为统治者，我必须得到宝珠。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: We'll leave a garrison at Serpentholm.
chinese: 我们会在 Serpentholm 留下一支守军。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: The thief is headed north.
chinese: 窃贼往北去了。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: No doubt he seeks an alliance with the Lotus or Wolf.
chinese: 他肯定是想与莲花族或恶狼族结盟。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: I will take the main army north into these provinces and make sure he finds only corpses to befriend.
chinese: 我会率主力北上，让他在这些地方只能找到死者作伴。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: These lands were once loyal to the Serpent.
chinese: 这些地方曾效忠灵蛇族。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: They must be brought back under control.
chinese: 必须让它们重新服从。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Burn them to the ground if they resist.
chinese: 他们要是反抗，就把村子烧光。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Otomo will follow behind and clean up the surviving rabble.
chinese: Otomo 会跟在后面，清理剩下的乌合之众。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: If they're loyal, they have nothing to fear from me.
chinese: 只要他们忠诚，就不必怕我。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: I kill to make the clan stronger.
chinese: 我杀人是为了让族人更强大。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: I carve away the fat and save the lean.
chinese: 我除掉无用之人，留下精兵。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: I won't tolerate cowards or shirkers.
chinese: 我不会容忍胆小鬼和不肯出力的人。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Which one are you, Otomo?
chinese: Otomo，你是哪一种？
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Then do what I say.
chinese: 那就照我说的做。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Watch him.
chinese: 看住他。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Since the Lotus were beaten at the Swan's Pool, they have lost every battle.
chinese: 自从莲花族在天鹅池战败，他们就一战接一战地输。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Finishing them here, before they retreat to their keep, would put an end to them once and for all.
chinese: 趁他们还没退回要塞，在这里彻底打败他们。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: The barbarous Wolf clan is still strong here, around the mines.
chinese: 恶狼族的主力还在矿区一带。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: A head-on assault would be costly, but would deprive the Wolf of their armories.
chinese: 正面强攻代价不小，但能夺走他们的兵器库。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: On the other hand, if I take the men through the swamps here, we might outflank the Wolf.
chinese: 但要是带人穿过沼泽，也许能绕到恶狼族侧翼。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: They would be forced to shift troops to counter, weakening them on other fronts.
chinese: 他们就得派兵应对，其他地方的防线也会变弱。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Pull, damn you!
chinese: 用力拉，该死的！
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: That's twice now.
chinese: 这已经是第二次了。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Set an example.
chinese: 拿他做个例子。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: You're one of Otomo's men.
chinese: 你是 Otomo 的人。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: By Otomo?
chinese: Otomo 干的？
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: To your posts!
chinese: 各就各位！
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Otomo, Otomo, Otomo...
chinese: Otomo，Otomo，Otomo……
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Why are you so eager to die?
chinese: 你为什么这么想死？
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: I would have let you live another year, perhaps even two.
chinese: 我本来还会让你多活一两年。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: Not bad.
chinese: 还不错。
status: draft; Kenji campaign v25; not game-tested

english: But look - there's still one peasant hut intact!
chinese: 但你看，还有一间农舍完好无损！

english: With your permission, I will claim it for the clan.
chinese: 如果你允许，我会替族人接管它。

english: A new peasant has just emerged from the peasant hut.
chinese: 一名新农民从农舍里出来了。

english: Select him.
chinese: 选中他。

english: Now you see the buildings the peasant can construct for you.
chinese: 现在可以看到农民能为你建造的建筑。

english: At the moment, you can only build another peasant hut or a target range.
chinese: 目前你只能再建一间农舍，或建一座靶场。

english: Left-click the target range icon, then right-click on the ground to place the new building.
chinese: 左键点击靶场图标，再右键点击地面放置新建筑。

english: You'll need additional rice and water to construct more buildings and train an army.
chinese: 要建更多建筑、训练军队，还需要更多稻米和水。

english: Select one peasant, then right-click on that rice field west of the village to begin harvesting rice.
chinese: 选中一名农民，再右键点击村西的稻田，让他开始收割。

english: There's also a stream to the north where we can obtain fresh water.
chinese: 北边还有一条小河，可以取到清水。

english: Send a peasant there as well.
chinese: 也派一名农民过去。

english: Now that we have a stockpile of rice and water, we should begin training some archers.
chinese: 现在稻米和水都有了，该开始训练弓箭手了。

english: Select a peasant, then right-click the target range.
chinese: 选中农民，再右键点击靶场。

english: Excellent!
chinese: 很好！

english: We must be careful.
chinese: 我们得小心。

english: The high road is easier travelling, but we're sure to be spotted.
chinese: 大路好走，但肯定会被发现。

english: The forest would mask our movements until we're ready to attack.
chinese: 穿过树林就能掩护我们的行动，直到准备进攻。

english: Come out, you madman!
chinese: 出来，你这个疯子！

english: Face me!
chinese: 来面对我！

english: You are your father's son...
chinese: 你真是你父亲的儿子……

english: Forget the Orb!
chinese: 别管宝珠了！

english: It's just a worthless rock!
chinese: 那不过是块没用的石头！

english: Look around you!
chinese: 看看周围！

english: We've taken Serpentholm - doesn't that matter?
chinese: 我们已经夺下 Serpentholm，这还不够吗？

english: It's meaningless.
chinese: 那毫无意义。

english: This is madness!
chinese: 这简直疯了！

english: We've no time for these fantasies about magic and dragons!
chinese: 没时间再幻想什么魔法和龙了！

english: You must restore the Serpent clan!
chinese: 你必须让灵蛇族再次强大！

english: Then I will.
chinese: 那我就来做。

english: We have to move quickly, while the other clans are weak.
chinese: 趁其他族还弱，我们必须快点行动。

english: Here, look.
chinese: 来，看这里。

english: Serpentholm is safe for the moment.
chinese: Serpentholm 暂时安全。

english: We'll set the engineers to rebuilding the walls in case our enemies return.
chinese: 得派人重修城防，以防敌人回来。

english: The Wolf clan's army has retreated to the hills.
chinese: 恶狼族的军队退进了山里。

english: By now, they're preparing to make a stand at the mines.
chinese: 这会儿他们应该正准备在矿区坚守。

english: If we hurry, we might take them unprepared.
chinese: 动作够快，也许能打他们一个措手不及。

english: Perhaps rather than attempting a frontal assault, we should press them on the flank.
chinese: 与其正面强攻，不如从侧翼逼近。

english: The valleys and swamps in this province could hide our army until we're ready to strike.
chinese: 这一带的山谷和沼泽能掩护军队，直到我们发动进攻。

english: You're hurt.
chinese: 你受伤了。

english: Not too much pain for you, I hope.
chinese: 希望你没有太痛苦。

english: Our enemies understand pain and sacrifice.
chinese: 我们的敌人懂得痛苦，也懂得牺牲。

english: They're doomed, of course, but at least they don't cower in their villages.
chinese: 他们注定失败，但至少没有躲在村里不敢出来。

english: Say?
chinese: 你说什么？

english: I don't have anything to say.
chinese: 我没什么可说的。

english: The Serpent clan needs strong leaders, not weaklings.
chinese: 灵蛇族需要强者领导，不能交给软弱的人。

english: Take him.
chinese: 把他带走。

english: As you wish.
chinese: 遵命。

english: You take weaklings under your wing.
chinese: 你竟然把软弱的人收在身边。

english: To you?  Never.
chinese: 向你屈服？绝不。

english: As I served the father, so shall I serve the son.
chinese: 我怎样侍奉父亲，就怎样侍奉儿子。

english: At the Swan's Pool.
chinese: 在天鹅池。

english: Not me...the Serpent.
chinese: 不是我……是灵蛇。

english: You can't trust the townsfolk.
chinese: 镇上的人不能信。

english: They're mercenary scum who serve the highest bidder.
chinese: 那群唯利是图的家伙，谁出价高就为谁效力。

english: We'd be better off going west, crossing the river here.
chinese: 最好往西走，从这里过河。

english: There's a Wolf clan shanty town on the other side, but a few well-trained soldiers could easily clear away that rabble.
chinese: 对岸有个恶狼族的棚户区，派出训练有素的士兵就能轻易清掉那群人。

english: It's like old times - the Serpent clan fighting as one again.
chinese: 仿佛回到了从前，灵蛇族又能并肩作战了。

english: A message from Riverside!
chinese: Riverside 送来了消息！

english: The Wolf clan is preparing to counterattack.
chinese: 恶狼族正准备反击。

english: We must head them off, or they'll sweep through the lowlands!
chinese: 必须挡住他们，不然他们会一路打到低地！

english: A large army of Lotus warriors is camped on the hillside below the warlock's tower.
chinese: 一支莲花族大军驻扎在术士塔下的山坡上。

english: We must attack, or they'll raid the southern coast!
chinese: 必须主动出击，否则他们会袭扰南部海岸！

english: I'll do it.
chinese: 我来办。

english: The other clans have come.
chinese: 其他各族也来了。

english: What is that?
chinese: 那是什么？

english: Our enemies are on the run.
chinese: 敌人正在溃逃。

english: Enough!
chinese: 够了！

english: Always have.
chinese: 一直如此。

english: What's your plan of attack?
chinese: 你打算怎么进攻？

english: This place stinks of death.
chinese: 这里满是死亡的气息。
